newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait exports $9.9bln oil in nine months to Sept.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait exports $9.9bln oil in nine months to Sept.

text.p: Kuwait's oil exports amounted to 2.997 billion dinars ($9.9 billion) in the nine months to September, a Commerce and Industry Ministry official said in remarks published on Thursday.
The figures published by al-Anba newspaper show a trade balance surplus of 1.347 billion dinars in the same period.
The official did not give comparison figures, but said non-oil exports for the same period amounted to 171.2 million dinars, while its imports amounted to 1.821 billion dinars.
Kuwait has an OPEC crude oil production quota of 2.0 million barrels per day (bpd). Oil is the desert state's main revenue earner.
The 1996/97 (July-June) state budget projects a 3.0 billion dinars revenue with a deficit of 1.2 billion dinars.
